Your agent memory should not be a giant chat-history dump

SimpleMem is a unified memory stack for LLM agents that stores, compresses, and retrieves long-term memories across text and multimodal inputs.

It helps you keep agents context-aware with less repeated history by turning interactions into compact memory units, indexing them with embeddings and metadata, then retrieving relevant memories by meaning and intent.

Key features:

• Semantic compression – distills raw interactions into self-contained memory units with resolved references and timestamps
• Auto-routed Python API – one SimpleMem() package selects text or multimodal backend from the first method you call
• Multimodal memory – supports text, image, audio, and video through the Python integration
• Retrieval optimization – simplemem.optimize(...) uses EvolveMem to tune retrieval configs on your own dev questions
• MCP option for text memory – cloud-hosted MCP service works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients

It’s open-source (MIT license).
